Hiraka Station Location within Aomori Prefecture Show map of Aomori Prefecture Hiraka Station Hiraka Station (Japan) Show map of Japan Hiraka Station ( 平賀駅 , Hiraka-eki ) is a railway station in Hirakawa, Aomori , Japan, operated by the private railway operator Kōnan Railway Company . Lines [ edit ] Hiraka Station is served by the Kōnan Railway Kōnan Line , and lies 7.5 kilometers from the northern terminus of the line at Hirosaki , Station layout [ edit ] Hiraka Station has a two opposed side platforms with an elevated station building; however, one of the platforms has not been in use since the discontinuation of the Kuroishi Line in 1998. The station is staffed and also serves as the operational headquarters for the Kōnan Line. (not in use) Adjacent stations [ edit ] « Service » Kōnan Railway Kōnan Line Tachita - Hakunōkōkōmae History [ edit ] Hiraka Station was opened on September 7, 1927. Freight operations were discontinued in 1984. Wicket gate operation was turned over to a separate company ( kan'i itaku ) in October 1985. A new station building was completed in December 1986. On June 12, 2007, an accident occurred at Hiraka Station when a Kuroishi-bound train derailed.
